participation.context: Looked, and did not write on the sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Had brought it, and left it for the minute.
participation.name: Michael Drayton

relations.note: the sheet is a visit, not a prize

story.body: You saw the sheet Drayton brought. Secretary, chancery and italic. You did not set your own hand down beside them.
